articles.body: When Internet infrastructure becomes dependent on geography, copyright law and the European sporting calendar. DNS BlockingOn November 24, 2026, Quad9, a Swiss non-profit organization operating one of the world’s best-known independent DNS services, stopped serving users in France. Not because of technical problems. Not because of insufficient demand. Not because operating DNS servers had become commercially unattractive. Quad9 withdrew following a legal dispute over unauthorized broadcasts of tennis matches. A European country has effectively lost access to an independent cybersecurity and Internet infrastructure service because of a dispute over sporting events. And France is not alone.

articles.body: A solid-fuel kitchen's last exhaust inspection was January 31, 2024. Its next three planning dates are February 29, March 31, and April 30. Calling setUTCMonth() to move January 31 into February gives March 2. Reusing February 29 as the anchor for the next projected visit gives March 29. Either arithmetic shortcut changes a deadline. Step Correct projected date Reason Last recorded inspection 2024-01-31 Start at the completion date Add one month 2024-02-29 February ends on day 29 Add two months 2024-03-31 March can use day 31 Add three months 2024-04-30 April ends on day 30 Keep two clocks per kitchen The exhaust track models NFPA 96 Table 12.4 inspection intervals for grease buildup. Solid fuel uses one month, high volume uses three, moderate volume uses six, and low volume uses twelve.

articles.body: Munchable reads ingredients lists. When a barcode is one we have never seen, the app opens a camera and the user photographs the panel on the back of the packet, which is six point type, printed on a curve, under supermarket lighting, held by someone who is also holding a trolley. I assumed that was a resolution problem. It is a focus problem. The phone in your pocket has plenty of pixels and no interest whatsoever in focusing on something eight centimetres from the lens unless you tell it to, and expo-camera gives you almost none of the controls you need to tell it. articles.title: Agent security from data access to execution boundaries
articles.excerpt: Protect the Entire Process from Reading to Output AI brings scattered information into context, then generates new content or actions. Data protection needs both to restrict initial access and to mana…
articles.body: Protect the Entire Process from Reading to Output AI brings scattered information into context, then generates new content or actions. Data protection needs both to restrict initial access and to manage the combined information and its eventual destination. Let retrieval permissions inherit the enterprise's existing authorization When connecting a knowledge base, document ownership, sensitivity levels and access permissions need to be retained. Retrieval should be filtered according to the current user or task identity, rather than relying only on blanket authorization when data is imported. When employees leave, roles change or document permissions change, indexes and caches should also be updated promptly to prevent old permissions from remaining in AI applications for long periods.

articles.excerpt: Astronomers witnessed the spectacular cosmic indigestion that resulted from a red giant star that devoured a stellar Bao bun in the form of its smaller companion star.
articles.body: Astronomers witnessed the spectacular cosmic indigestion that resulted from a red giant star that devoured a stellar Bao bun in the form of its smaller companion star. That isn't a random comparison. The cannibal star, which is 350 times bigger than the sun, is nicknamed "Big Bao," while its unfortunate companion had the nickname "Little Bao." The cute cosmic monikers come from the fact that this destructive merger event has been designated AT2025abao. A Bao bun might be a little snack for a human, but this red giant star made a real meal out of Little Bao. This cannibalistic event was tracked by a wide array of ground- and space-based telescopes, including NASA space missions NEOWISE, SPHEREx, and the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST), as well as the W. M. Keck Observatory in Hawaii.

articles.title: 'Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home' at 40: 'Trek' has never been as joyous or fun as in 'the one with the whales'
articles.excerpt: Colorful metaphors, a near-miss with Eddie Murphy and humpback whales in 20th-century California.
articles.body: It may have been subtitled "The Voyage Home", but to most viewers "Star Trek IV" (which has just turned 40) will always be "the one with the whales". After "The Wrath of Khan" and "The Search for Spock" went to some pretty dark places — ear worms, the destruction of the Enterprise, the death (and later resurrection) of a certain beloved Vulcan — the franchise was in need of some light relief. So what better than to set coordinates for the then-present day of 1986 San Francisco, for a time-travel comedy romp? Spock himself, Leonard Nimoy, had directed "The Search for Spock" and Paramount had lined him up to call the shots on a follow-up before the movie had even landed in theaters.
